loading_mode: In-memory HTML (Playwright set_content; file:// not exercised)

annotation_overlap_check.method: getBBox of every gold (#eab676) filled or stroked element that is not itself a monospace code token (numeric literals share the gold colour) against every monospace code text element inside the panel, in every scene state and variant.

limitations: Checks canvas bounds and annotation-versus-code bounding boxes, not every possible overlap or semantic correctness.
Typography depends on installed fonts for editable sources; rendered media is frozen.
